Following the positive performance, RTX also raised its full-year 2026 sales and earnings outlook.
events.title: Why Is RTX (RTX) Down 3.4% Since Last Earnings Report?

events.summary: PPG Industries, Inc. has introduced its SEM brand of automotive refinish products in Mexico, expanding its offerings in the automotive repair industry. The SEM brand, known for abrasives, detailing products, masking solutions, and aerosol repair systems, aims to help automotive specialists achieve professional finishes and reduce waste. This launch strengthens PPG's market position by providing comprehensive solutions beyond coatings to meet the demands of Mexican automotive painters.
events.title: PPG Launches SEM Automotive Refinish Products in Mexico

events.summary: Ford Motor Company's shares are rising due to increased investor interest in its Ford Energy battery storage subsidiary, projected to reach a $10 billion valuation. Additionally, strong government incentives for electric commercial vehicles, particularly in California, are expected to boost Ford's fleet replacement cycles and pricing power. Technical analysis shows the stock in an intermediate uptrend, though a "death cross" from April suggests potential choppiness in pullbacks.
events.title: Ford Shares Edge Higher Thursday: What's Driving The Move?

events.summary: Deere & Company's shares fell despite beating earnings expectations, as the manufacturer's weak outlook for large agricultural equipment sales overshadowed its strong performance. This cautionary guidance suggests potential challenges in the agricultural sector, leading investors to react negatively to the future prospects rather than the past quarter's results.
events.title: Deere shares tumble after weak large-ag outlook overshadows earnings beat

events.summary: Cummins Inc. (CMI) shares dropped 4.6% following its 2026 Analyst Day, where investors re-evaluated near-term demand and spending priorities. The decline may also be due to "sell-the-news" trading after the company recently raised its full-year revenue guidance. The article also details significant insider selling, hedge fund activity, government contracts, congressional stock trading, and analyst ratings for CMI.
events.title: Cummins shares slide 4.6% as investors digest Analyst Day updates and near-term demand mix
